picks.why: Dream-1 claims zero-shot control of unseen bimanual robots out of the box, backed by $90M and a public API - a concrete shot at robotics' data cold-start problem.
Meta's October 30 terms make enterprises solely liable for its AI's mistakes, including features Meta enables itself - a liability inversion every AI customer will now have to price.
Apollo's chief economist shows flat revenue-per-worker and margins across the S&P 493: the strongest data-driven case yet that the AI payoff is confined to tech.
Inside Meta's decade-old team that uses AI plus human review to catch school-shooting threats - 800 law-enforcement referrals last year - with all the tension that implies.
DetectorScope turns black-box AI text detectors into auditable sums of named, located features - interpretability you can read, at almost no accuracy cost.
